video_title: Srbija, NBA, Toronto i proces: Darko Rajaković

quotes.speaker: Darko Rajaković
quotes.summary_phrase: Nikola Jokic is the best Serbian player of all time
quotes.excerpt: Nikola Jokić is the best Serbian player of all time, and one of the best in sports history.
quotes.quote: Nikola Jokić is the best Serbian player of all time, and one of the best in sports history.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Mislim da je Nikola Jokić najbolji srpski igrač svih vremena, i jedan od najboljih igrača u istoriji sporta.

quotes.speaker: Darko Rajaković
quotes.summary_phrase: Coaches cannot succeed without good players
quotes.excerpt: There is no coach and there is no success for a coach without players.
quotes.quote: There is no coach and there is no success for a coach without players.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Ja mislim da nema trenera i da nema uspeha za trenera bez igrača.

quotes.speaker: Darko Rajaković
quotes.summary_phrase: Focus on things you can control as a coach
quotes.excerpt: You have to focus on things that you control.
quotes.quote: You have to focus on things that you control.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Znači moraš da se fokusiraš na stvari koje ti kontrolišeš.

quotes.speaker: Darko Rajaković
quotes.summary_phrase: Larry Tanenbaum's decision to hire Darko Rajaković
quotes.excerpt: Larry Tanenbaum said after my conversation with him, I don't want to interview anyone else, give the job to Darko.
quotes.quote: Larry Tanenbaum said after my conversation with him, I don't want to interview anyone else, give the job to Darko.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Tek kasnije sam saznao da Larry Tanenbaum posle mog razgovora sa njim je rekao ne želim ni da intervjuišem ostalu dvojicu, dajte posao Darku.

quotes.speaker: Darko Rajaković
quotes.summary_phrase: Darko Rajaković's humble beginnings in Memphis
quotes.excerpt: I ate at McDonald's for a month and ate with a dollar menu.
quotes.quote: I ate at McDonald's for a month and ate with a dollar menu.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Hranio sam se mesec dana u McDonald's-u kao u onom dokumentarcu i jeo sam sa dolar menija.

quotes.speaker: Darko Rajaković
quotes.summary_phrase: The importance of difficult moments in life
quotes.excerpt: There were moments that were truly turning points in my life.
quotes.quote: There were moments that were truly turning points in my life.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Jer bilo je trenutaka koji su stvarno bili prekretnice u mom životu.

quotes.speaker: Darko Rajaković
quotes.summary_phrase: No one is special in the NBA
quotes.excerpt: None of you is special. None of us here is special.
quotes.quote: None of you is special. None of us here is special.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Niko od vas nije specijalan. Niko od nas ovde nije specijalan.

quotes.speaker: Darko Rajaković
quotes.summary_phrase: The question is deep
quotes.excerpt: The question is excellent, but the question is deep.
quotes.quote: The question is excellent, but the question is deep.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Postavio si pitanje odlično, pa pitanje je duboko.

quotes.speaker: Darko Rajaković
quotes.summary_phrase: The importance of team play and humanitarian actions
quotes.excerpt: Our style of play and the assists are connected to the humanitarian action.
quotes.quote: Our style of play and the assists are connected to the humanitarian action.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Za ono što mi gradimo i kako gradimo i naš stil igre i asistencije koje pomeneš koje su vezane za humanitarnu akciju koju smo pokrenuli ja i moja supruga.

quotes.speaker: Darko Rajaković
quotes.summary_phrase: God's will for Darko Rajaković's coaching career
quotes.excerpt: The situation I am in is a situation where God himself put me to be a coach in the NBA.
quotes.quote: The situation I am in is a situation where God himself put me to be a coach in the NBA.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Slažem se mislim da situacija u kojoj sam je situacija gde me sam Gospod Bog postavio da budem trener u NBA.

quotes.speaker: Darko Rajaković
quotes.summary_phrase: Finding ways to give back to society
quotes.excerpt: I am already in the position where I need to find a way how to return to society.
quotes.quote: I am already in the position where I need to find a way how to return to society.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Smatram kad sam postavljen već u tu poziciju da treba da pronađem način kako da vratim društvu.

quotes.speaker: Darko Rajaković
quotes.summary_phrase: The impact of the St. Jude hospital
quotes.excerpt: I saw that the hospital does an incredible job and that everything is absolutely free for children.
quotes.quote: I saw that the hospital does an incredible job and that everything is absolutely free for children.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: I video sam da ta bolnica radi neverovatan posao da je sve apsolutno besplatno za decu.

quotes.speaker: Darko Rajaković
quotes.summary_phrase: Funding for St. Jude hospital comes from people with low income
quotes.excerpt: Almost 90 percent of all funds collected for that hospital come from people who have low income.
quotes.quote: Almost 90 percent of all funds collected for that hospital come from people who have low income.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: I on kaže da skoro 90 posto svih sredstava koja se prikupe za tu bolnicu dolaze od ljudi koji imaju nizak nizak primanja.

quotes.speaker: Darko Rajaković
quotes.summary_phrase: The importance of talking to players
quotes.excerpt: Always approach people to talk to them, to see what is happening in their lives.
quotes.quote: Always approach people to talk to them, to see what is happening in their lives.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Uvek priđeš ljudima da porazgovaraš sa njima, da vidiš šta se dešava u njihovim životima.

quotes.speaker: Darko Rajaković
quotes.summary_phrase: Family is the biggest support
quotes.excerpt: To me, my family helps the most, my wife and my son, they are definitely my biggest support.
quotes.quote: To me, my family helps the most, my wife and my son, they are definitely my biggest support.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Meni pomaže najviše moja porodica, moja moja supruga i sin, oni su mi definitivno moja najveća podrška.

quotes.speaker: Darko Rajaković
quotes.summary_phrase: Toronto fans love basketball
quotes.excerpt: The city loves basketball, which was not the case 15 or 20 years ago.
quotes.quote: The city loves basketball, which was not the case 15 or 20 years ago.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Grad obožava košarku, što nije bio slučaj pre nekih 15 ili 20 godina.

quotes.speaker: Darko Rajaković
quotes.summary_phrase: Younger generations follow basketball more than hockey
quotes.excerpt: Younger generations follow basketball much more than they follow baseball, than they follow hockey.
quotes.quote: Younger generations follow basketball much more than they follow baseball, than they follow hockey.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Naročito mlađe generacije, mlađi ljudi mnogo više prate košarku nego što prate bejzbol, nego što prate hokej.

quotes.speaker: Darko Rajaković
quotes.summary_phrase: Everything is a matter of perception
quotes.excerpt: Everything is a matter of perception.
quotes.quote: Everything is a matter of perception.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Mislim da je sve stvar percepcije.

quotes.speaker: Darko Rajaković
quotes.summary_phrase: Ranko Zeravica's coaching philosophy
quotes.excerpt: Ranko Žeravica talked about how coaches make a mistake and that victory is the most important thing.
quotes.quote: Ranko Žeravica talked about how coaches make a mistake and that victory is the most important thing.
quotes.verbatim_original_language: Jer Ranko Žeravica je pričao da treneri prave grešku i da postavljanju pobeda je najbitnija stvar.

quotes.speaker: Aleksandar Stojanović
quotes.summary_phrase: Aleksandar Stojanović asks Darko Rajaković to share his coaching knowledge in Serbia
quotes.excerpt: I want you to make an incredible process, I won't say victory, but I will say process.

text_blocks.speaker: Aleksandar Stojanović
text_blocks.text: Above all, for your work, for what you represent, and for what you represent, I want you to make an incredible process. I won't say victory, but I will say process, and if you make a process, there will be victories. I want you one day to transfer that knowledge of yours here in the way you choose. You already know what I'm assuming you know what I'm thinking, but this, and I will try as much as I can to try to help, for example, next summer, for something to be organized for those seminars for the transfer of knowledge to young coaches and young people.

text_blocks.speaker: Darko Rajaković
text_blocks.text: I will try as much as I can to try to help, for example, next summer, for something to be organized for those seminars for the transfer of knowledge to young coaches and young people, and that is what I can tell you. Don't resent me, I had many things to ask, but I have some energy, process, but can we interpret this Darko as a process in our future conversations, to note, you know, as you said, you promised me and so on.

quotes.speaker: Darko Rajaković
quotes.summary_phrase: Darko Rajaković thanks Aleksandar Stojanović for the interview
quotes.excerpt: Thank you for the excellent and pleasant conversation. Thank you for not looking at your phone.

text_blocks.speaker: Darko Rajaković
text_blocks.text: Thank you for the excellent and pleasant conversation. Thank you for not looking at your phone to ask questions, but we really had a conversation. Natural and normal, and I really enjoyed it, thank you for the invitation.

text_blocks.speaker: Aleksandar Stojanović
text_blocks.text: Thank you too, Darko, all the best. It was a conversation with Darko Rajaković.
